item.title: President Lee Nominates Kye Seung-gyun, Pusan National University Professor, as Chair of the National Intellectual Property Committee (李대통령, 국가지식재산위원장에 계승균 부산대 교수 지명)
item.description:
President Lee Nominates Kye Seung-gyun, Pusan National University Professor, as Chair of the National Intellectual Property Committee (李대통령, 국가지식재산위원장에 계승균 부산대 교수 지명)

President Lee Jae-myung nominated Kye Seung-gyun, a professor at Pusan National University, as the chair of the National Intellectual Property Committee, according to a written briefing delivered by Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong on the 1st. The National Intellectual Property Committee is an organization under the President's authority, responsible for deliberating, coordinating, and reviewing policies in the field of intellectual property. (이재명 대통령은 국가지식재산위원회 위원장에 계승균 부산대 교수를 지명했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 1일 서면 브리핑을 통해 밝혔다. 국가지식재산위원회는 대통령소속 기관으로, 지식재산 분야의 정책을 심의·조정·점검하는 역할을 한다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang described the new Chair Kye as "a legal scholar well-versed in intellectual property legislation who has expanded his expertise to include AI (artificial intelligence) and public contracts, and an expert who has contributed to the development of intellectual property policy and legislation through various government committees and academic activities." (강 수석대변인은 계 신임 위원장에 대해 “지식재산 법제에 정통하고 AI(인공지능), 공공계약에까지 전문성을 넓혀온 법학자로, 다양한 정부 위원회 및 학회 활동을 통해 지식재산 정책과 법제 발전에 기여한 전문가”라고 설명했다.)

She further stated, "He is the right person to proactively respond to changes in the new technology environment, such as AI and digital transformation, and to go beyond the creation and protection of intellectual property to make it a core driver of national growth," adding, "He will faithfully fulfill the role of a control tower for national intellectual property strategy by enhancing the professionalism and effectiveness of the National Intellectual Property Committee." (이어 “AI·디지털 전환 등 신기술 환경 변화에 선제적으로 대응해 지식재산 창출과 보호를 넘어 지식재산을 국가 성장의 핵심 동력으로 만들 적임자”라며 “국가지식재산위원회의 전문성과 실효성을 제고해 국가 지식재산 전략의 컨트롤타워 역할을 충실히 수행할 것”이라고 했다.)

Chair Kye, a legal expert in intellectual property rights, serves as a professor in the Division of Convergence Studies at Pusan National University and is also active as the president of the Korean Intellectual Property Society and a non-standing committee member of the Korea Copyright Commission. (지적재산권 관련 법 전문가인 계 위원장은 부산대 융합학부 교수로 재직하면서 한국지식재산학회 회장, 한국저작권위원회 비상임위원 등으로도 활동 중이다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "I Urged Police Reform as Prime Minister... We Must Uproot the Six Major Malpractices" (김민석 “총리 시절 경찰개혁 당부했는데… 6대 폐단 뿌리 뽑아야”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "I Urged Police Reform as Prime Minister... We Must Uproot the Six Major Malpractices" (김민석 “총리 시절 경찰개혁 당부했는데… 6대 폐단 뿌리 뽑아야” )

On the 1st, at the first meeting of the Police Reform Promotion Task Force, Democratic Party of Korea leader Kim Min-seok said, "When I was prime minister, I asked the police themselves fairly early on to come up with a police reform plan, but the results were not satisfactory" and "It seems that it is difficult for them to create a reform plan on their own." (더불어민주당 김민석 대표는 경찰개혁추진단 첫회의가 열린 1일 “제가 총리 시절, 꽤 일찍 경찰 개혁안을 만들어야 된다고 경찰 자체에 당부를 했는데, 그렇게 만족할 만은 못했다”며 “아무래도 자체적으로 개혁안을 만든다는 건 어려운 일인 것 같다”고 했다.)

Kim said on the same day, "Various measures must be devised as much as possible to uproot the six major malpractices of the police, including covering for their own." He added, "The six major malpractices can be seen as covering up cases involving their own, arbitrary case closures, evidence concealment and fabrication, leaks of investigative information, and infringement of personal information." (김 대표는 이날 “제 식구 감싸기 등 경찰의 6대 폐단을 뿌리 뽑을 수 있도록 여러가지 대책이 최대한 강구돼야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서“‘제 식구 감싸기’ 사건 암장, 무단 종결, 증거 은폐와 증거 조작, 수사 정보 유출, 개인정보 침해 등을 6대 폐단이라고 볼 수 있다”고 했다.)

He also said, "As ways to uproot all of these, various measures must be devised as much as possible, such as expanding external audits, strengthening grounds for investigation recusal, strengthening explanations and accountability to victims, strengthening legal liability for negligent investigations, and strengthening protection of personal information and privacy." (또 “이런 걸 다 뿌리 뽑을 수 있는 방법으로 외부 감사 확대, 수사 제척 사유 강화, 피해자에 대한 설명·책임 강화, 부실 수사에 대한 법적 책임 강화, 개인정보와 사생활 보호 강화 등 여러가지 대책이 최대한 강구돼야 한다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Lee Hae-sik, co-head of the Police Reform Promotion Task Force, emphasized, "The demand for democratic control and reform of the police has become a routine task since democratization, but at this point when prosecution reform is being completed, it has become an inevitable and indispensable task of the times" and "The public's anger over the recent series of incidents involving the police, such as the Jang Yun-gi case and the deputy police chief case, shows the urgency and earnestness of police reform." (경찰개혁추진단 공동단장을 맡은 이해식 의원은 “경찰에 대한 민주적인 통제와 개혁의 요구는 민주화 이후에 일상적 과제가 됐으나 검찰개혁이 마무리되는 이 즈음에는 필연적이고 필수 불가결한 시대적 과제가 됐다”며 “최근 장윤기 사건, 부경장 사건 등 경찰을 둘러싸고 벌어졌던 일련의 사건에 대한 국민 분노는 경찰개혁에 대한 시급성과 절실성을 보여준다”고 강조했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Nam-hee, who serves as co-head alongside Lee, also said, "We will not start with a predetermined conclusion" and "President Lee Jae-myung has also emphasized the necessity and importance of police reform several times. We will create a system where the party and the government communicate and cooperate together, find solutions that can work on the ground, and push them forward." (이 의원과 함께 공동단장을 맡은 김남희 의원도 “결론을 정하고 출발하지 않겠다”며 “이재명 대통령도 경찰개혁 필요, 중요성을 여러 번 강조했다. 당정이 함께 소통하고 협력하는 체계를 만들어 현장에서 작동할 수 있는 해결책을 찾아 추진하겠다”고 말했다.)

After the meeting, Kim Nam-hee met with reporters and said, "Since discussions are also underway in the government, we will establish a governance structure for party-government consultations" and "We agreed to carry out necessary discussions through close communication with bodies such as the National Police Agency's Investigation Reform Committee and the police reform organization that the Prime Minister's Office has said it will launch." (김남희 의원은 회의를 마치고 취재진과 만나 “정부에서도 관련된 논의가 진행되고 있어서 당정 협의를 하는 거버넌스를 구축할 것”이라며 “경찰청 수사개혁위원회라든지, 총리실에서 출범하겠다고 한 경찰개혁 기구와 긴밀한 소통을 통해 필요한 논의를 해 나가자고 했다”고 전했다.)

item.title: Justice Minister Nominee Kim Seung-won Sends Text to Seo Young-kyo Explaining 'New Drug Lobbying Allegations'... "I Apologize" (법무장관 후보 김승원, 서영교에 ‘신약 청탁 의혹’ 해명 문자… “송구합니다”)
item.description:
Justice Minister Nominee Kim Seung-won Sends Text to Seo Young-kyo Explaining 'New Drug Lobbying Allegations'... "I Apologize" (법무장관 후보 김승원, 서영교에 ‘신약 청탁 의혹’ 해명 문자… “송구합니다”)

Kim Seung-won, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea nominated as the Minister of Justice, was caught by press cameras on the 1st at the National Assembly plenary session sending a text message to Seo Young-kyo, chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, explaining the allegations of 'lobbying for approval of a COVID-19 clinical trial' for which he was previously investigated by prosecutors. After detailing the circumstances of the case and his own arguments, the nominee wrote, "I apologize." (법무부 장관 후보자로 지명된 김승원 더불어민주당 의원이 1일 국회 본회의장에서 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장에게 자신이 과거 검찰 수사를 받은 ‘코로나19 치료제 임상시험 승인 청탁 의혹’과 관련한 해명 문자메시지를 보내는 장면이 취재진 카메라에 포착됐다. 김 후보자는 사건 경위와 자신의 주장을 설명한 뒤 “송구합니다”라고 적었다.)

On the screen of Kim's phone captured by Kookmin Ilbo cameras that day was written: "Although 11 prosecutors were deployed for a three-year investigation, there was no direct evidence of a '5 million won promise,' no actual preferential treatment existed, and even the court related to the case denied any consideration for brokering, yet the prosecution left only Kim Seung-won with a suspended indictment—this is the core argument of the constitutional complaint." He then sent a summary of the relevant details to Chair Seo and added, "I apologize." (이날 국민일보 카메라에 포착된 김 후보자의 휴대전화 화면에는 “3년간 검사 11명을 투입해 수사했지만 ‘500만원 약속’의 직접증거도 없고, 실제 특혜도 없었으며, 관련 사건 법원마저 알선 대가성을 부정했는데 검찰은 김승원 의원에게만 기소유예 처분을 남겼다는 것이 헌법소원의 핵심 주장”이라는 내용이 적혀 있었다. 이어 서 위원장에게 관련 내용을 요약해 보낸 뒤 “송구합니다”라고 했다.)

The case Kim mentioned is a suspicion of lobbying surrounding the approval of a clinical trial for a COVID-19 treatment being developed by a company in 2021. Prosecutors investigated the process in which Professor Kang, the founder of the company, asked a broker named Yang to help obtain approval for the clinical trial from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, and Yang requested that Kim, then a lawmaker, ensure that the ministry's related work be expedited. Kim was suspected of having accepted Yang's request and asking the then-commissioner of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety to allow the treatment to undergo clinical trials. (김 후보자가 언급한 사건은 2021년 한 업체가 개발하던 코로나19 치료제의 임상시험 승인을 둘러싼 로비 의혹이다. 검찰은 해당 업체 설립자인 강모 교수가 브로커 양모씨에게 식품의약품안전처의 임상시험 승인을 받을 수 있도록 도와달라고 부탁했고, 양씨가 당시 국회의원이던 김 후보자에게 식약처의 관련 업무가 신속히 처리되도록 해달라는 취지로 요청한 과정을 수사했다. 김 후보자는 양씨의 부탁을 받고 당시 식약처장에게 해당 치료제가 임상시험을 받을 수 있도록 해달라고 요청한 혐의를 받았다.)

During the investigation, circumstances were also confirmed in which Kang's side attempted to send approximately 5 million won to Kim's political donation account, and prosecutors investigated Kim for charges including bribery. In December 2024, the Seoul Western District Prosecutors' Office issued a suspended indictment for Kim's bribery charges. (수사 과정에서는 강씨 측이 김 후보자의 정치후원금 계좌로 약 500만원을 보내려 한 정황도 확인됐고, 검찰은 이를 포함해 김 후보자의 뇌물수수 등 혐의를 수사했다. 서울서부지검은 2024년 12월 김 후보자의 뇌물수수 혐의에 대해 기소유예 처분을 내렸다.)

A suspended indictment differs from a no-charge disposition. Under current prosecution case rules, a suspended indictment is defined as 'a case where the suspected facts are acknowledged, but it is determined that prosecution is not necessary in consideration of the motive and consequences of the crime and the circumstances of the suspect.' In other words, it is a non-prosecution disposition in which the prosecution acknowledges the suspected facts but does not bring the case to trial. (기소유예는 무혐의 처분과는 다르다. 현행 검찰사건사무규칙은 기소유예를 ‘피의사실이 인정되지만 범행 동기와 결과, 피의자의 사정 등을 참작해 소추할 필요가 없다고 판단하는 경우’로 규정하고 있다. 즉 검찰이 피의사실을 인정하면서도 재판에는 넘기지 않는 불기소 처분이다.)

At the time, Kim denied the allegations during the prosecution's investigation, stating that he had only relayed a related civil complaint and had not engaged in any improper lobbying. He later filed a constitutional complaint arguing that his suspended indictment was unjust, and the text sent to Chair Seo that day appears to contain these same arguments. (김 후보자는 당시 검찰 조사에서 관련 민원을 전달했을 뿐 부정한 로비를 한 것은 아니라는 취지로 혐의를 부인했다. 이후 자신의 기소유예 처분이 부당하다며 헌법소원을 제기했고, 이날 서 위원장에게 보낸 문자에도 이 같은 주장이 담긴 것으로 보인다.)

Earlier, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon said at the National Assembly Special Committee on Budget and Accounts the previous day, "There is a fact that prosecutors investigated Kim for having received a request from an acquaintance to help grant approval for a COVID-19 new drug and then relaying that request to the commissioner of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety." The text Kim sent to Chair Seo is understood to have been an attempt to explain the course of the investigation and his position regarding the allegations raised by Han. (앞서 한동훈 무소속 의원은 전날 국회 예산결산특별위원회에서 “김 후보자가 코로나 신약 치료제를 허가해 달라고 지인으로부터 청탁을 받아 식품의약품안전처장에게 청탁한 사실에 대해 검찰이 수사한 사실이 있다”고 했다. 김 후보자가 서 위원장에게 보낸 문자는 한 의원의 문제 제기 이후 관련 사건의 수사 경위와 자신의 입장을 설명하려 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Regarding the text message, Kim's side said, "He explained to the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee the facts concerning Han's claims." (김 후보자 측은 문자메시지에 대해 “한 의원의 주장에 대해 사실관계에 관한 내용을 법사위원장에게 설명한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Party Ethics Inspection Team Vice Chief's Message to Pro-Lee Senior Member: "Jung Chung-rae Faction Seems to Be Moving on Kim Ki-pyo" (與감찰단, 친명 최고위원에 “정청래 세력이 김기표 작업” 문자)
item.description:
Party Ethics Inspection Team Vice Chief's Message to Pro-Lee Senior Member: "Jung Chung-rae Faction Seems to Be Moving on Kim Ki-pyo" (與감찰단, 친명 최고위원에 “정청래 세력이 김기표 작업” 문자)

A text message sent by the vice chief of the Democratic Party of Korea's Ethics Inspection Team to a pro-Lee Jae-myung senior member, Park Sun-won, was captured by journalists' cameras in the National Assembly plenary chamber on the 1st. The message read, "It seems Jung Chung-rae's faction has started working on Rep. Kim Ki-pyo" and "We should get there quickly and take control." (더불어민주당 윤리감찰단 부단장이 친명(친이재명)계 박선원 최고위원에게 “정청래 세력들이 김기표 의원 작업 들어온 듯하다” “빨리 가서 장악해야 할 듯하다”고 보낸 문자메시지가 1일 국회 본회의장에서 취재진 카메라에 포착됐다.)

It was interpreted that an official of the party's inspection body, newly appointed under the leadership of Representative Kim Min-seok, was wary and suspected that associates of former leader Rep. Jung Chung-rae were trying to interfere in the additional appointment of Ethics Inspection Team members. Controversy arose as it became known that the incumbent vice chief used expressions such as "Jung Chung-rae faction," "work on," and "take control" regarding the appointments of the party's internal disciplinary body. (김민석 대표 체제에서 새로 임명된 당 감찰기구 간부가 직전 대표인 정청래 의원 측 인사들이 윤리감찰단 추가 인선에 관여하려 한다고 의심하며 이를 경계한 것으로 해석됐다. 당내 비위를 감찰하는 기구의 인선을 놓고 현직 부단장이 ‘정청래 세력’ ‘작업’ ‘장악’이라는 표현을 사용한 사실이 알려지면서 논란이 일었다.)

The figures mentioned in the message are connected to the appointment of the Ethics Inspection Team by both the current and former leadership. On the 21st of last month, Representative Kim appointed former prosecutor Rep. Kim Ki-pyo as head of the Ethics Inspection Team directly under the party leader, and ten days later on the 31st, appointed Kang Min-gu, a professor at Myongji University's Industry-Academic Cooperation Foundation, as vice chief. Jang In-jae, mentioned in Vice Chief Kang's message, is a former prosecution investigator who served as vice chief of the Ethics Inspection Team under former leader Jung's administration. Representative Kim and former leader Jung competed for party leadership at the party convention last month. (메시지에 등장하는 인물들은 현·전 지도부의 윤리감찰단 인선과 연결돼 있다. 김 대표는 지난달 21일 검사 출신 김기표 의원을 당대표 직속 윤리감찰단장에 임명했고, 열흘 뒤인 31일 강민구 명지대 산학협력단 교수를 부단장으로 선임했다. 강 부단장이 문자에서 거론한 장인재씨는 정 전 대표 체제에서 윤리감찰단 부단장을 지낸 검찰 수사관 출신 인사다. 김 대표와 정 전 대표는 지난달 민주당 전당대회에서 당권을 놓고 경쟁했다.)

The message that Senior Member Park checked on his mobile phone at the opening ceremony of the regular parliamentary session that day contained content related to the appointment of an additional vice chief for the Ethics Inspection Team. Vice Chief Kang told Senior Member Park, "They say they're recommending another person as vice chief. That is, Jang In-jae and someone else." (이날 국회에서 열린 정기국회 개회식에서 박 최고위원이 휴대전화로 확인한 메시지에는 윤리감찰단의 추가 부단장 인선과 관련한 내용이 담겼다. 강 부단장은 박 최고위원에게 “부단장을 또 다른 사람 추천한다고 해서요. 장인재하고 누구 한 명을요”라고 했다.)

Vice Chief Kang continued, "Since Jang In-jae, from Jung Chung-rae's side, is a former prosecution investigator, it seems they've started working on Rep. Kim Ki-pyo." This passage appears to show Vice Chief Kang suspecting that the side of former Vice Chief Jang, a former prosecution investigator, was asking or persuading Head Kim, a former prosecutor who currently leads the Ethics Inspection Team, regarding the appointment of an additional vice chief. However, it has not been confirmed whether former Vice Chief Jang or those close to former leader Jung actually made any requests or demands to Head Kim regarding personnel matters. (강 부단장은 이어 “정청래 쪽 장인재 부단장이 검찰 수사관 출신이라서 김기표 의원한테 작업 들어온 듯하다”고 했다. 검사 출신인 김 단장이 윤리감찰단장을 맡고 있는 상황에서, 검찰 수사관 출신인 장 전 부단장 측이 김 단장을 상대로 추가 부단장 인선을 부탁하거나 설득하고 있다고 강 부단장이 의심한 것으로 읽히는 대목이다. 다만 장 전 부단장이나 정 전 대표 측이 실제 김 단장에게 인사와 관련한 부탁이나 요구를 했는지는 확인되지 않았다.)

Vice Chief Kang then said, "It seems Jung Chung-rae's faction has started working on Rep. Kim Ki-pyo." He added, "They haven't contacted me to come to the central party office, so I was hoping you could put in a word with the secretary-general," requesting help from Senior Member Park before saying, "We should get there quickly and take control." It was also revealed that he had sent Article 26 of the party rules, which stipulates the composition and operation of the Ethics Inspection Team. (강 부단장은 이어 “정청래 세력들이 김기표 의원 작업 들어온 듯하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “저 중앙당에서 출근하라고 연락이 안 와서요. 사무총장한테 얘기 좀 해주셨으면 해서요”라고 박 최고위원에게 도움을 요청한 뒤 “빨리 가서 장악해야 할 듯하다”고 했다. 윤리감찰단 구성과 운영 근거가 담긴 민주당 당규 제26조도 함께 보낸 것으로 나타났다.)

The content of the message was interpreted as showing that Vice Chief Kang was wary of the possibility that a figure from the previous leadership's side might rejoin as vice chief during the process of reorganizing the Ethics Inspection Team after Representative Kim took office. In particular, controversy was also raised over the neutrality of the inspection body's operations, as it became known that the incumbent vice chief of the Ethics Inspection Team, which investigates misconduct by the party's elected public officials and key party officials, used expressions such as "work on" and "take control" regarding appointments. (문자 내용은 김 대표 취임 후 윤리감찰단을 새로 구성하는 과정에서 전임 지도부 측 인사가 다시 부단장으로 합류할 가능성을 강 부단장이 경계하고 있었음을 보여주는 것으로 해석됐다. 특히 당 소속 선출직 공직자와 주요 당직자의 비위 등을 감찰하는 윤리감찰단의 현직 부단장이 인선을 두고 ‘작업’과 ‘장악’이라는 표현을 쓴 사실이 알려지면서 감찰기구 운영의 중립성을 둘러싼 논란도 제기됐다.)

As controversy erupted, Representative Kim ordered the immediate dismissal of Vice Chief Kang that day. The party's Public Relations Bureau announced in a press notice, "Party Leader Kim Min-seok has ordered the immediate dismissal of Ethics Inspection Team Vice Chief Kang Min-gu." Vice Chief Kang, who was appointed on the 31st of last month, received the dismissal order just one day after his appointment. (논란이 불거지자 김 대표는 이날 강 부단장의 즉시 해임을 지시했다. 민주당 공보국은 언론 공지를 통해 “김민석 당대표께서는 윤리감찰단 강민구 부단장의 즉시 해임을 지시하였습니다”라고 밝혔다. 강 부단장은 지난달 31일 임명된 지 하루 만에 해임 지시를 받게 됐다.)

Senior Member Park maintains that he had nothing to do with the appointment discussions. He told Segye Ilbo, which captured the screen of his mobile phone, "It was someone unilaterally sending it to me, and I did nothing myself. I was just sitting there when the message came, so I looked at it to see what it was." Former Vice Chief Jang also said, "I'm not involved with the party at all right now, so I don't know anything. I haven't done anything, and I have nothing to do with it." (박 최고위원은 자신은 해당 인선 논의와 무관하다는 입장이다. 그는 자신의 휴대전화 화면을 포착한 세계일보 측에 “남이 일방적으로 나한테 보낸 것이고, 내가 한 것도 없다”며 “가만히 있는데 메시지가 와서 뭐가 왔나 하고 들여다본 것”이라고 했다. 장 전 부단장도 “나는 당에 지금 전혀 관여하지 않고 있어 잘 모른다”며 “아무것도 한 게 없고 전혀 관계없다”고 했다.)

item.title: NIS Launches Inspection into 'Anti-North Korea Operations TF' (‘北 공작 대응 TF’ 감찰 나선 국정원)
item.description:
NIS Launches Inspection into 'Anti-North Korea Operations TF' (‘北 공작 대응 TF’ 감찰 나선 국정원)

The National Intelligence Service (NIS) has reportedly begun a large-scale inspection since the 25th of last month in connection with the December 3 martial law declaration. It is conducting a special audit to determine whether the 'Task Force (TF) for Countering North Korean Influence Operations,' which was established and operated at the NIS during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, functioned as surveillance of civilians. (국가정보원이 12·3 비상계엄과 관련해 지난달 25일부터 대대적인 감찰에 착수한 것으로 1일 전해졌다. 윤석열 정부 시절 국정원에 설치돼 활동했던 ‘북한 영향력 공작 대응 태스크포스(TF)’가 민간인 사찰 역할을 한 것이 아닌지 등을 특별 감찰한다는 것이다.)

The NIS reported this at a closed-door plenary session of the National Assembly's Intelligence Committee on this day, according to a briefing by Rep. Yoon Kun-young of the Democratic Party, the ruling party's secretary at the committee. Rep. Yoon held a press conference at the National Assembly on the 20th of last month, claiming that this TF, formed by the NIS in early 2024, effectively conducted "surveillance of civilians." He alleged that the NIS's report to then-President Yoon in January 2024, titled 'Plan for Operating and Tracking a Special Response TF to Block North Korean Influence Operations,' included Kim Min-woong, head of the Candlelight Action and brother of current Democratic Party leader Kim Min-seok, and Yang Kyung-soo, chairman of the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU), as "tracking targets," and that "political trend reports unrelated to North Korea" were made. <<> In response to related questions at the meeting, the NIS stated, "There are concerns and worries about civilian surveillance. Depending on the results of the special inspection, we intend to take personnel measures as well," Rep. Yoon said. <<> Meanwhile, regarding the frequent media exposure of Kim Ju-ae, daughter of North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un, the NIS said it "views this as effectively the stage of designating a successor." It analyzed that "there appears to be a purpose of imprinting her as a leader on North Korean residents." <<> The NIS also reported that it "has secured and is analyzing (North Korean Workers' Party) internal documents and missile blueprints," according to Rep. Yoo Young-ha of the People Power Party, the opposition party's secretary at the committee. Rep. Yoo did not provide specific details regarding the "missile blueprints." <<> North Korea recently expanded the 'Reconnaissance General Bureau,' an organization under the People's Army General Staff responsible for collecting intelligence and conducting operations against South Korea and overseas, into the 'Reconnaissance Intelligence General Bureau.' Regarding the background, the NIS reportedly assessed that it aims to strengthen counterintelligence functions and to entrust Reconnaissance General Bureau Director Ri Chang-ho with handling operational intelligence from the Ukraine war. Ri Chang-ho led the column of overseas operation units at the military parade commemorating the 9th Party Congress last February in his capacity as director of the Reconnaissance Intelligence General Bureau. The NIS also reported that it had blocked the leakage of advanced domestic technology, including blueprints for a new nuclear reactor and photos of the Surion helicopter engine. (국정원은 이날 국회 정보위원회 비공개 전체회의에서 이같이 보고했다고 정보위 여당 간사인 더불어민주당 윤건영 의원이 브리핑에서 전했다. 윤 의원은 지난달 20일 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 국정원이 2024년 초 구성한 이 TF가 “사실상 민간인 사찰”을 했다고 주장했다. 2024년 1월 국정원이 윤 전 대통령에게 보고한 ‘북 영향력 공작 차단을 위한 특별대응 태스크포스(TF) 운영 및 추적 계획’에 김민석 현 민주당 대표의 형인 김민웅 촛불행동 대표와 양경수 민주노총 위원장 등이 ‘추적 대상자’로 포함됐으며 “북한과는 관련이 없는 정치 동향 보고”가 이뤄졌다는 주장이었다.)

item.title: NIS: US-North Korea Summit Could Happen at Any Time This Year (국정원 “북미 정상회담, 올해 언제라도 열릴 수 있다”)
item.description:
NIS: US-North Korea Summit Could Happen at Any Time This Year (국정원 “북미 정상회담, 올해 언제라도 열릴 수 있다”)

The National Intelligence Service stated on the 1st that a summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un could take place at any time this year, and that it is discussing support measures in this regard. A senior NIS official said during a full session of the National Assembly's Intelligence Committee on the 1st regarding the U.S.-North Korea summit, "We should view it as possible at any time (from now)." The official added, "There is no fact-check on specific U.S.-North Korea contacts, but we should see that there are signs of dialogue," according to Democratic Party lawmaker Yoon Kun-young and People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Yong-ha, who serve as the committee's ruling and opposition whips. This came after President Trump hinted last month at the possibility of a meeting with Chairman Kim Jong-un, with South Korean intelligence authorities also releasing analysis supporting this. <<> There are also signs that the White House is preparing for a U.S.-North Korea summit. Kelly McKeague, director of the Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency (DPAA) under the U.S. Department of Defense, said he recently received a query from the White House about what activities the DPAA could undertake if the U.S. and North Korean leaders reach an agreement. Speaking at a discussion hosted by the National Committee on North Korea (NCNK), a Washington D.C.-based civilian organization, on the 31st of last month, McKeague said, "(The current situation) is no different from the period around the 2018 Singapore U.S.-North Korea summit," and that he told the White House, "We are ready to cooperate with North Korea." <<> The DPAA's moves are drawing attention because the repatriation of U.S. soldiers' remains played a key role as a link in U.S.-North Korea dialogue during the first summit in 2018. In July 2018, shortly after the Singapore summit, a U.S. Air Force transport plane received the remains of U.S. soldiers from the Korean War contained in 55 boxes at North Korea's Wonsan Kalma Airfield and transported them to Osan Air Base. <<> Amid these moves by the South Korean and U.S. governments, some foreign policy and security experts are analyzing that attention should be paid to the possibility that Trump could make a surprise visit to North Korea before the U.S. midterm elections on November 3. Trump enjoys drawing media attention with dramatic events, and having already held U.S.-North Korea summits in third countries like Singapore and Hanoi, he could be interested in visiting Pyongyang. Nam Sung-wook, a chair professor at Sookmyung Women's University (former president of the Institute for National Security Strategy), said, "The characteristic of an 'October surprise' by Trump in October is that Kim Jong-un holds the decision-making power," adding, "If Kim Jong-un proposes a summit in Pyongyang, Trump is highly likely to accept." Professor Nam stated, "Trump is sincere about meeting Kim Jong-un, even disclosing top-secret information that North Korea has 57 nuclear weapons," predicting that for the first time ever, a U.S.-North Korea summit could be held on Kim Jong-un's "home turf." The possibility is that Trump would effectively recognize North Korea as a nuclear-armed state in exchange for securing a "moratorium" including the suspension of intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) development that threatens the U.S. mainland, and then tout this as his diplomatic achievement. A government official said, "For Kim Jong-un, following Russian President Putin's visit in 2024 and Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Pyongyang last June, he could advertise both domestically and internationally that even Trump came to North Korea to meet him," adding, "Unlike the 2019 'Hanoi no-deal,' he could judge this as not an unfavorable game." <<> There is also counterargument. Park Won-gon, a professor of North Korean studies at Ewha Womans University, predicted, "A U.S.-North Korea summit is likely to take place this fall, but the possibility of Pyongyang being the venue is low." Professor Park said, "For Trump to visit Pyongyang, his security detail would need to conduct advance reconnaissance to the extent of thoroughly inspecting Pyongyang, which seems technically infeasible." Professor Park noted that since the first and second U.S.-North Korea summits were held in ASEAN countries, candidates this time could include Russia's Vladivostok. <<> There is also analysis that if Trump visits North Korea, he might prefer Wonsan over Pyongyang as the meeting venue. Kim Dong-suk, president of the Korean American Grassroots Conference (KAGC) who recently visited South Korea, said, "I have observed Trump for a long time since his days as a New York businessman, and if he visits North Korea, beyond the purpose of a political pivot, he could be interested in the Kalma area of Wonsan from a business perspective." At the first U.S.-North Korea summit in Singapore in June 2018, Trump referenced "beautiful beaches" reminiscent of North Korea's Wonsan and emphasized the potential for tourism development in the Kalma district. Trump, a former real estate developer, directly mentioned coastal tourism development while explaining economic compensation following North Korea's denuclearization. The Wonsan Kalma Airfield has a precedent of Asiana Airlines charter flights operating there during the 2018 Pyeongchang Winter Olympics, and it is reportedly not problematic for Air Force One to take off and land. (국가정보원은 1일 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장 간의 정상회담이 올해 중 언제라도 열릴 수 있다고 보고 이와 관련한 지원 방안을 논의 중이라는 입장을 밝혔다. 국정원 고위 관계자는 1일 국회 정보위원회 전체 회의에서 미북 정상회담과 관련, “(지금부터) 어느 때라도 가능하다고 봐야 한다”고 했다. 이 관계자는 “북미 간의 구체적 접촉에 대한 팩트체크는 없지만, 대화의 징후는 있다고 봐야 한다”며 이같이 말했다고 정보위 여야 간사인 민주당 윤건영 의원, 국민의힘 유영하 의원이 밝혔다. 지난달 트럼프 대통령이 김정은 위원장과의 회담 가능성을 시사한 후, 한국 정보 당국도 이를 뒷받침하는 분석을 내놓은 것이다.)

item.title: Once Again, Kim Min-seok's "Resignation Demand" Worked (이번에도 김민석의 ‘사퇴 요구’ 통했다)
item.description:
Once Again, Kim Min-seok's "Resignation Demand" Worked (이번에도 김민석의 ‘사퇴 요구’ 통했다)

It has been reported that Kim Min-seok, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, influenced the sudden resignation of Kim Yong-beom, the chief of staff for policy at the presidential office, on the 1st. It is said that Representative Kim suggested to President Lee Jae-myung that Chief Kim resign, and President Lee accepted the recommendation, leading to the replacement. On the 25th of last month, after a dinner between President Lee and the Democratic Party leadership, Representative Kim also met with the president alone and requested that the appointment of Youn Yeo-han, a former People Power Party lawmaker, as president of the Korean Red Cross be reconsidered, and the presidential office stated that it would review the matter. A ruling camp official explained, "Unlike the Jung Cheong-rae leadership, the launch of the Kim Min-seok leadership, which is close to the president, is enhancing government momentum and efficacy through communication between the party and the presidential office." <<> It is known that Representative Kim, immediately after being elected party leader on the 17th of last month, met with Democratic Party lawmakers to hear their views on the recent decline in the president's approval rating and other issues. In particular, during a recent workshop for Democratic Party lawmakers, he reportedly gathered opinions on replacing the party's policy lineup and conveyed them to the presidential office. A key Democratic Party figure said, "Many lawmakers relayed to Representative Kim the talk of Chief Kim's dismissal, and Representative Kim exchanged opinions with Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik and Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo." <<> The presidential office has also accepted Representative Kim's views on other issues. Ahead of the August 17 national convention, President Lee had advocated for partially retaining the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, while Representative Kim had called for their complete abolition. However, after the presidential office changed its position, the supplementary investigative powers were fully abolished. Additionally, on the 23rd of last month, Representative Kim proposed revisions to the government's real estate tax reform plan during a high-level party-government consultative meeting. Subsequently, when the government announced a revised plan on that day, it was assessed that Representative Kim's opinions had been adopted as they were. (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 1일 전격 사퇴한 데는 김민석 더불어민주당 대표가 영향을 미친 것으로 전해졌다. 김 대표가 이재명 대통령에게 김 실장의 사퇴를 건의했고, 이 대통령이 이를 받아들이면서 교체가 이뤄졌다는 것이다. 김 대표는 지난달 25일 이 대통령과 민주당 지도부 만찬 후 대통령과 독대해서도 인요한 전 국민의힘 의원의 대한적십자사 회장 인준을 재고해 달라고 요청했고, 청와대가 이를 검토하겠다는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다. 여권 관계자는 “정청래 지도부와 달리 대통령과 가까운 김민석 지도부 출범으로 당청 의견 교감을 통해 국정 동력과 효능감을 높이고 있는 것”이라고 설명했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "A Shift in Direction Is Needed, Calling It a Dismissal Would Be Disappointing" (김용범 “국면 전환 필요, 경질이라 하면 섭섭해”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "A Shift in Direction Is Needed, Calling It a Dismissal Would Be Disappointing" (김용범 “국면 전환 필요, 경질이라 하면 섭섭해”)

Kim Yong-beom, chief of staff for policy at the presidential office, said in a phone call with this newspaper on the 1st regarding his resignation, "If we need to speed up policy implementation but lack the momentum, we must quickly shift the direction." He noted that he took into account the frustrating situation, including the recent decline in approval ratings for state affairs. In particular, mentioning that the Lee Jae-myung administration has entered its second year, he said, "I told the president that since Chapter 1 is over, we need to make a major shift in direction with new people and new energy in areas like social polarization." <<> Director Kim said, "I have expressed my intention to resign several times before, and this was not a sudden decision." Regarding the assessment from some quarters that it was a "dismissal," he said, "Calling it a dismissal would be disappointing." He added, "I had expressed my intention to resign before, but the president kept persuading me to stay. This time, he finally gave a kind of approval." <<> Regarding public opinion holding him responsible for the sharp fluctuations in the stock market and real estate policies, Director Kim said, "Domestic and international conditions were extremely challenging, unlike anything anyone had experienced before," but added, "It is natural for people to be angry about areas where policies were handled negligently." <<> Regarding the revisions to the government's real estate-related tax reform proposal made at the Cabinet meeting that day, Director Kim said, "Consistency in government policy is important, but the party's position that revisions were necessary also had merit," adding, "I suggested creating a middle-ground adjustment plan, and the president also issued a revision order yesterday (the 31st)." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 1일 본지 통화에서 사퇴 이유에 대해 “정책 추진에 속도를 내야 하는데 동력이 부족한 상황이라면 빨리 국면 전환을 해야 하기 때문”이라고 말했다. 최근 국정 지지율 하락 등으로 답답한 상황임을 감안했다는 것이다. 특히 이재명 정부가 출범 2년 차에 접어든 점을 언급하며 “챕터 1이 끝났으니 이제 새 사람, 새 에너지로 사회 양극화 이런 분야에서 기조 전환을 크게 해야 한다고 (대통령에게) 말했다”고 했다.)

item.description:
[Episode 47] Those Who Charge Into the Trap ([47화] 덫으로 돌진하는 자들)

"Huff! Ha!" (“흡! 하!”)

"No." (“안 돼.”)

Finding no words to refute her, Evan simply stared at her furious face, dumbfounded. (이리나의 말에 반박할 말이 딱히 없어, 멍하니 성난 얼굴만 바라봤다.)

Prey that knows the trap's location is no longer prey. (덫의 위치를 아는 사냥감은 더 이상 사냥감이 아니다.)

Suddenly the resolve he had made in the hospital room came to mind. Back then, it had sounded like a noble line. (문득 병실에서 했던 다짐이 떠올랐다. 그때는 근사한 문장처럼 들렸다.)

Now, he felt like a wild boar charging into a trap it knew was waiting. (지금은 덫에 걸릴 걸 알면서도 돌진하는 멧돼지 같았다.)

item.title: Senior US official: "President Trump disappointed in allies that did not help denuclearize Iran" (美 고위 당국자 “트럼프 대통령, 이란 비핵화 안 도운 동맹에 실망”)
item.description:
A senior US government official said on the 1st, "President Donald Trump has clearly expressed disappointment (disappointment) in the many allies that did not support the United States on the issue of Iran's denuclearization," adding, "The President has made clear since his first term that all allies must spend more on their capacity to contribute to the 'Peace through Strength' initiative." Amid Trump's repeated recent remarks that South Korea did not assist in military operations against Iran and his statement that "I will remember this," the official gave this response when asked by this publication for further comment on the matter. (미국 정부 고위 당국자는 1일 “도널드 트럼프 대통령은 이란 비핵화 문제에 있어서 미국을 지지하지 않은 많은 동맹국에 실망감(disappointment)을 분명히 표명했다”며 “대통령은 1기 때부터 모든 동맹이 ‘힘을 통한 평화(Peace through Strength)’ 구상에 기여할 수 있는 역량에 더 많은 비용을 지출해야 한다는 점을 분명히 해왔다”고 밝혔다. 트럼프가 최근까지 여러 차례 한국이 대(對)이란 군사 작전을 돕지 않은 점을 언급하며 “이를 기억할 것”이라 말한 가운데, 이 당국자는 이와 관련된 추가 입장을 묻는 본지 질의에 이같이 답했다.)

In a Fox News interview released on the 30th of last month, Trump said, "The United States spends billions of dollars to help NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) and other countries, but gets almost no help in return," and cited "South Korea as a prime example." He said, "We have 40,000 troops stationed (in South Korea), and when we asked for help regarding Iran, they said, 'We'd rather not.'" He recounted, "We didn't push them hard, but we asked if they would participate (in support on the Iran situation), and they said, 'no, thank you.'" He added, "Because they have no willingness to help us, I can't be a stupid person (who only gives help)," suggesting the possibility of increased pressure for burden-sharing. (트럼프는 지난달 30일 공개된 폭스뉴스 인터뷰에서 “미국은 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구)와 다른 나라를 돕기 위해 수십억 달러를 쓰고 있지만 거의 도움을 받지는 못한다”며 “한국이 바로 그 예시”라고 했다. 그는 “우리는 4만명의 병력을 (한국에) 두고 있는데 그들은 이란과 관련해 도와달라는 요청에 ‘차라리 안 하겠다(We’d rather not)’고 말했다”며 “(한국을) 강하게 밀어붙이지는 않았지만 (이란 상황에 대한 지원에) 참여하겠냐고 물었고 그들은 ‘사양하겠다(no, thank you)’고 말했다”고 전했다. 그러면서 “그들은 우리를 도와주려는 의지가 없는데 (우리만 도움을 주는) 멍청한 사람(stupid person)이 될 수는 없기 때문”이라고 말해 추가 부담 분담 압박 가능성을 시사했다.)

Trump also indirectly expressed his displeasure last month by revealing his phone call with President Lee Jae-myung and noting that South Korea had declined his request for support. A Cheong Wa Dae official said on the 1st regarding Trump's remarks, "South Korea is actively participating in international efforts to swiftly normalize global maritime logistics networks," and explained, "We are reviewing practical and military contribution measures for freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, taking into account readiness on the Korean Peninsula and procedures under domestic law." President Lee had also said, "We will seek ways to contribute to international efforts for peace and security in the Strait of Hormuz within the bounds permitted by domestic law and the government's basic policies." (트럼프는 지난달에도 이재명 대통령과의 통화 사실을 공개하며 한국이 지원 요청을 사양한 것에 대한 불만을 우회적으로 드러냈다. 청와대 관계자는 1일 트럼프의 발언과 관련, “한국이 글로벌 해상 물류망의 조속한 정상화를 위한 국제적 노력에 적극 참여하고 있다”며 “한반도 대비 태세, 국내법상 절차 등을 종합적으로 고려해 호르무즈 해협의 통항 자유를 위한 실질적·군사적 기여 방안을 검토하고 있다”고 설명했다. 이 대통령도 “국내법과 정부 기본 정책이 허용하는 범위 안에서 호르무즈 해협의 평화와 안전을 위한 국제 사회 노력에 기여할 수 있는 방안을 모색할 것”이라고 했었다.)

item.title: Kim Seung-won sends "I apologize" text to Seo Young-kyo... 'New Drug Lobbying Suspicion' Under Scrutiny (김승원, 서영교에 “송구합니다” 문자… 도마 오른 ‘신약 로비 의혹’)
item.description:
Kim Seung-won sends "I apologize" text to Seo Young-kyo... 'New Drug Lobbying Suspicion' Under Scrutiny (김승원, 서영교에 “송구합니다” 문자… 도마 오른 ‘신약 로비 의혹’)

"Chairman, here is a summary of the Food and Drug Safety Ministry-related matter. I apologize." (“위원장님, 식약처 관련 내용 요약입니다. 송구합니다.”)

Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice (Democratic Party lawmaker), sent this text message on the 1st at the opening ceremony of the regular National Assembly session held in Yeouido, Seoul, to Seo Young-kyo, the Democratic Party chair of the National Assembly Legislation and Judiciary Committee. The message conveyed his intention to file a constitutional complaint against the prosecution's decision to suspend indictment on charges of promising to arrange bribes, which he deemed unjust. A suspension of indictment is a disposition in which the prosecution acknowledges the suspicion but postpones filing charges. The opposition party is pointing to Kim as the "top priority for removal" among the nominees for the second-term cabinet under the Lee Jae-myung administration. The 'Food and Drug Safety Ministry lobbying suspicion' case involving Kim is also subject to scrutiny. (김승원 법무부 장관 후보자(더불어민주당 의원)는 1일 서울 여의도에서 열린 정기국회 개회식에서 민주당 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장에게 이 같은 문자메시지를 보냈다. 알선뇌물약속 혐의에 대해 검찰로부터 기소유예 처분을 받았는데 부당해서 헌법소원을 낸다는 취지다. 기소유예는 혐의가 인정되지만 검찰이 공소 제기를 미루는 처분이다. 야당은 이재명 정부 2기 내각 장관 후보자 가운데 김 후보자를 “낙마 대상 0순위”로 꼽고 있다. 김 후보자와 관련된 ‘식약처 로비 의혹’ 사건도 검증 대상이다.)

The case involves allegations that in October 2021, when Kim was a first-term lawmaker, he accepted a request from a broker surnamed Yang and asked a then-commissioner of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, surnamed Kim, to expedite the clinical trial approval for a COVID-19 treatment developed by Company A. Kang, the founder of Company A and a university professor, had asked Yang, a fellow graduate school attendee, to inquire about ways to fast-track the ministry's clinical trial approval through political channels, and Yang relayed the request to Kim, whom he knew. According to the prosecution's investigation results, Kim indeed called and texted the ministry commissioner asking him to "look into it." (이 사건은 김 후보자가 초선 의원 때인 2021년 10월 브로커 양모씨의 부탁을 받고 김모 식품의약품안전처장에게 A 제약사의 코로나 치료제 임상시험을 챙겨달라고 청탁했다는 의혹이다. A 제약사 설립자이자 대학교수인 강모씨는 같은 대학원에 다니던 양씨에게 정치권을 통해 식약처 임상시험 승인을 빨리 받는 방법을 문의했고, 양씨가 알고 지내던 김 후보자에게 요청했다는 것이다. 김 후보자는 실제 식약처장에게 전화와 문자메시지로 “챙겨봐 달라”는 취지로 요청했다는 게 검찰 수사 결과다.)

The ministry approved Company A's clinical trial plan just two weeks after Kim's phone call with the commissioner. It was also confirmed that Kang received Kim's campaign donation account from Yang and attempted to deliver 500,000 won in political donations. However, it is reported that Kim's donation account had already reached its annual donation limit that year, so the money was not transferred. (식약처는 김 후보자가 식약처장과 통화한 지 2주 만에 A사 임상시험 계획을 승인했다. 강씨가 양씨에게 김 후보자의 후원 계좌를 전달받아 정치후원금 500만원을 전달하려 한 정황도 확인됐다고 한다. 다만 김 후보자의 후원 계좌는 그해 후원 한도가 이미 차 돈이 전달되지 않았던 것으로 전해졌다.)

The prosecution indicted Kang, the pharmaceutical company representative, and the broker Yang, but in December 2024 notified Kim of a suspension of indictment on the charge of promising to arrange bribes. This is reportedly because the donation was never actually made and no direct contact between Kim and Kang was confirmed. Kang and Yang, however, are standing trial on charges of promising to offer bribes. (검찰은 제약업체 대표 강씨와 브로커 양씨를 기소했지만, 김 후보자의 알선뇌물약속 혐의에 대해서는 2024년 12월 기소유예를 통보했다. 실제 후원이 이뤄지지 않았고, 김 후보자와 강씨가 직접 연락한 사실이 확인되지 않았기 때문으로 알려졌다. 다만 강씨와 양씨는 뇌물공여약속 등의 혐의로 재판을 받고 있다.)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon raised the suspicion of Kim's lobbying of the Food and Drug Safety Ministry at the National Assembly on the 31st of last month. Han said on the same day, "The process of Kim directly lobbying the ministry commissioner and reporting the results to the broker has been starkly revealed through text messages and other evidence. A person like this should not serve as Minister of Justice, who must uphold fairness and justice." The People Power Party, regarding Kim, who had argued for the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung, demanded on that day, "Withdraw the nomination of the minister in charge of dropping indictments." The party stated that if a confirmation hearing is held, the Food and Drug Safety Ministry lobbying suspicion would also be rigorously examined. (무소속 한동훈 의원은 지난 31일 국회에서 김 후보자의 식약처 로비 의혹을 제기했다. 한 의원은 이날도 “김 후보자가 식약처장에게 직접 로비하고, 그 결과를 브로커에게 전달한 과정이 문자메시지 등으로 적나라하게 드러났다”며 “이런 사람이 공정과 정의를 지켜야 할 법무부 장관을 해서는 안 될 것”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 이재명 대통령 재판 공소취소를 주장했던 김 후보자와 관련해 이날 “공소취소 담당 장관을 지명 철회하라”고 요구했다. 인사청문회가 열릴 경우 식약처 로비 의혹도 집중 검증하겠다는 입장이다.)

However, the Democratic Party has stated it will conclude the National Assembly confirmation hearings before September 24, when the Chuseok holiday begins. The confirmation hearing targets include the six ministerial nominees designated by President Lee on the 30th, as well as Supreme Court justices and the nominee for special inspector of the presidential office, totaling eight people. A key Democratic Party official said, "With the prosecution service being abolished on October 2 and the new Public Prosecution Office and Major Crimes Investigation Office opening, the Minister of Justice must be appointed promptly to proceed with follow-up work. In particular, at a time when the president's approval ratings are falling, we must not drag out the hearing process, and the formation of the second-term cabinet must not be delayed to maintain momentum in the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (하지만 민주당은 국회 인사 청문회를 추석 연휴가 시작되는 9월 24일 전까지 마무리하겠다고 밝혔다. 인사청문회 대상은 이 대통령이 지난 30일 지명한 6개 부처 장관을 비롯해 대법관, 청와대 특별감찰관 후보자 등 총 8명이다. 민주당 핵심 관계자는 “10월 2일 검찰청이 폐지되면서 문을 여는 공소청, 중수청 후속 작업을 위해 법무장관이 조속히 임명돼야 하는 상황”이라며 “특히 대통령 지지율 하락 국면에서 청문 정국을 질질 끌면 안 되고, 이재명 정부 2년 차 국정 동력을 위해서도 2기 내각 구성이 지연되면 안 된다”고 했다.)

In particular, it is known that if Kim is appointed Minister of Justice, he will also take steps toward withdrawing the indictment in President Lee's case. To this end, the Democratic Party is reviewing the handling of a special counsel bill on manipulated indictments. Initially, the plan was to grant the special counsel the authority to withdraw indictments, but this issue will be re-discussed in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee in the future. (특히 김 후보자는 법무부 장관에 임명되면 이 대통령 사건의 공소취소를 위한 절차도 밟을 것으로 알려졌다. 이를 위해 민주당은 조작기소 특검법 처리를 검토하고 있다. 당초 특검에게 공소 취소 권한을 부여하기로 했지만 이 문제는 향후 법사위에서 재논의할 예정이다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, the Democratic Party elected Kim Ui-kyum, a second-term lawmaker, as the ruling party's secretary on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. In October 2022, during the committee's parliamentary audit of the Ministry of Justice, Kim raised the so-called 'Cheongdam-dong drinking session suspicion,' alleging that President Yoon Suk Yeol and then-Minister of Justice Han Dong-hoon had a late-night drinking session at a bar in Cheongdam-dong, Seoul, with around 30 lawyers from Kim & Chang law firm. This was proven false during a police investigation, and Kim is currently standing trial. An opposition party official said, "Because of the important role the hardline Kim is expected to play, he was entrusted with the secretary position despite various controversies." (이런 가운데 이날 민주당은 법사위 여당 간사에 재선의 김의겸 의원을 선출했다. 김 의원은 2022년 10월 법사위 법무부 국정감사에서 윤석열 대통령과 한동훈 당시 법무부 장관이 김앤장 법률사무소 변호사 30여 명 등과 서울 청담동의 한 술집에서 심야 술자리를 가졌다는 이른바 ‘청담동 술자리 의혹’을 제기했다. 이는 경찰 조사에서 거짓으로 드러났고 김 의원은 재판을 받고 있다. 야당 관계자는 “강경파인 김 의원의 역할이 중요하기 때문에 각종 논란에도 간사를 맡긴 것 아니겠느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Tug-of-war among supporters? On the first day of Democratic Party TV, Kim Eo-jun sees donor ‘jackpot’ (지지층 기싸움? 민주당TV 첫방날, 김어준은 후원금 ‘대박’)
item.description:
Tug-of-war among supporters? On the first day of Democratic Party TV, Kim Eo-jun sees donor ‘jackpot’ (지지층 기싸움? 민주당TV 첫방날, 김어준은 후원금 ‘대박’)

The YouTube channel 'Democratic Party TV (Minti),' launched under the leadership of Democratic Party of Korea Representative Kim Min-seok, aired its first broadcast at 7 a.m. on the 1st. It was praised as a success, drawing as many as 50,000 concurrent viewers at one point. However, during the same time slot, over 55 million won in donations reportedly poured into Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel 'Humility is Hard: News Factory.' That figure is 2.4 times the donations he received over the past month. (더불어민주당 김민석 대표가 주도해 띄운 유튜브 ‘민주당TV(민티)’가 1일 아침 7시 첫 방송을 했다. 한 때 5만명의 동시접속자가 몰리며 흥행에 성공했다는 평가를 받았다. 하지만 같은 시간대 김어준씨의 유튜브 ‘겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’에는 5500만원이 넘는 후원금이 쏟아진 것으로 알려졌다. 김씨가 지난 한 달간 받은 후원금의 2.4배 수준이다.)

On Minti, Representative Kim appeared as the first guest. Previously, the party's official YouTube channel, 'Deli Minju,' only livestreamed leadership meetings or press conferences, but right after being elected, Representative Kim ordered changes to it, vowing to produce Democratic Party-focused news. However, both inside and outside the party, some questioned the scheduling of YouTube programs in the same time slot, asking, "Isn't this a move to check Kim Eo-jun?" (민티에는 이날 김 대표가 첫 게스트로 출연했다. 직전 민주당 공식 유튜브 ‘델리민주’는 지도부 회의나 기자회견만 생중계하는 채널이었는데, 김 대표는 당선되자마자 이를 바꿔 민주당 중심의 뉴스를 만들겠다며 개선을 지시한 바 있다. 하지만 당 안팎에선 같은 시간대 유튜브 편성에 “김어준을 견제하는 것 아니냐”는 말도 나왔었다.)

On that day, Kim Eo-jun, upon hearing the peak concurrent viewer count of Democratic Party TV on his YouTube show, joked, "I heard (pro-government supporters) rushed over," and "Should I host (Democratic Party TV)?" According to the YouTube analytics site 'Playboard,' supporters also flocked to Kim's channel that day, bringing in over 55 million won in donations, with viewership surging to 200,000—more than double his usual numbers. The comment section was filled with messages like "Let's protect Kim Eo-jun" and "Go, Kim Eo-jun." Rather than being overshadowed, viewers rallied around him. In pro-government circles, remarks surfaced such as, "Is the Democratic Party support base splitting in two like this?" (이날 김어준씨는 유튜브에서 민주당TV의 최대 동시접속자 수를 전해 듣고 “(여권 지지자들이) 몰려갔다고 들었다” “내가 (민주당TV) 사회 할까”라는 농담을 던졌다. 유튜브 통계 분석 사이트 ‘플레이보드’에 따르면, 이날 김씨 채널에도 지지자들이 몰려 5500만원 이상의 후원금을 받았고, 시청자 수는 평소의 2배가 넘는 20만명까지 치솟았다. 댓글창에는 “우리가 김어준을 지키자” “김어준 화이팅” 등의 응원이 이어졌다. 오히려 김씨를 지지하는 시청자들이 결집한 것이다. 여권에선 “이렇게 민주당 지지층이 둘로 쪼개지는 건가”란 말도 나왔다.)

That day, lawmaker Noh Jong-myeon appeared on Kim Eo-jun's program and faced criticism from supporters who asked, "Why are you going elsewhere instead of the party's YouTube channel?" Noh rebutted on his Facebook page, saying, "It's unthinkable to ban or intimidate lawmakers from appearing on News Factory with the launch of Democratic Party TV in mind." Representative Kim Min-seok commented on Noh's post, saying, "A ban on appearances? Of course not. There will be more and diverse cooperation ahead. Good work, Lawmaker Noh." <<>> (이날 노종면 의원은 김어준씨 방송에 나갔다가 “왜 당 유튜브가 아닌 다른 곳에 나가냐”며 지지자들의 비판을 받기도 했다. 노 의원은 자신의 페이스북에 “민주당TV 출범에 맞춰 의원들의 뉴스공장 출연을 금지시키거나 위축시킨다는 건 있을 수 없는 일”이라고 반박했다. 김민석 대표는 노 의원의 글에 댓글을 달고 “출연금지? 당연히 없다. 더 많은 다양한 협력이 있을 거다. 노 의원님 수고하셨다”고 했다.)

item.title: U.S. Next-Generation Core Forces to Be Deployed to South Korea (美 차세대 핵심 부대, 한국에 배치)
item.description:
U.S. Next-Generation Core Forces to Be Deployed to South Korea (美 차세대 핵심 부대, 한국에 배치)

It was reported on the 1st that the U.S. Army has decided to deploy part of its next-generation core force, the Multi-Domain Task Force (MDTF), to the Korean Peninsula and has begun consultations with the South Korean government. Several hundred personnel from the "Multi-Domain Effects Battalion (MDEB)," responsible for cyber warfare, information warfare, and space warfare among the 2nd Multi-Domain Task Force forces covering Europe, are expected to be added to U.S. Forces Korea (USFK). (미 육군이 차세대 핵심 전력인 ‘다영역 특임단(Multi-Domain Task Force·MDTF)’ 중 일부를 한반도에 배치하기로 결정하고 우리 정부와 협의에 들어간 것으로 1일 전해졌다. 유럽을 담당하는 제2 다영역 특임단 전력 중 사이버전·정보전·우주전 등을 담당하는 ‘다영역 효과대대(MDEB)’ 전력 수백 명이 주한미군으로 증원될 전망이다.)

The Multi-Domain Task Force is the U.S. Army's newest rapid-mobility unit capable of operating across land, ground, sea, cyber, and space domains. China and Russia have adopted an "Anti-Access/Area Denial (A2/AD)" strategy to block U.S. forces from entering or operating freely within their spheres of influence, and the U.S. military created the Multi-Domain Task Force to neutralize this. The relocation of some of these forces to the Korean Peninsula is interpreted as serving both to deter North Korea's nuclear program and to check China. (다영역 특임단은 육상·지상·해상과 사이버·우주 영역에서 모두 작전이 가능한 미 육군의 최신예 신속 기동 부대다. 중국·러시아는 자국 영향권에 미군이 진입하거나 자유롭게 작전하는 것을 차단하려는 ‘반접근·지역거부(A2/AD)' 전략을 취하고 있는데, 이를 무력화하기 위해 미군이 창설한 것이 다영역 특임단이다. 미국이 그중 일부를 한반도로 이동 배치하는 데는 북핵 억지와 함께 중국 견제 성격도 있는 것으로 풀이된다.)

The U.S. side is reportedly aiming to complete the deployment of the "Multi-Domain Effects Battalion" to the Korean Peninsula within this year, a unit capable of detecting enemy movements through various channels and conducting non-physical attacks such as electronic jamming and interference, cyber attacks, space warfare, and psychological operations. When asked whether formal notification to the South Korean government has been completed, USFK said, "Please direct inquiries on related matters to the U.S. Department of the Army." (미국 측은 다양한 경로로 적의 동향을 탐지하고 전파 방해·간섭, 사이버 공격, 우주전, 심리전 등의 비물리적 공격을 할 수 있는 ‘다영역 효과대대’의 연내 한반도 배치 완료를 목표로 하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 우리 정부에 공식 통보가 끝났는지에 대해 주한미군은 “관련 사안은 미 전쟁부에 문의해달라”고 했다.)

◇ "U.S. Next-Generation Force with Early Detection Capabilities... Maximizing Precision Strike Effectiveness of USFK" (◇“美 차기 전력, 조기 탐지 능력 갖춰… 주한미군 정밀 타격 효과 극대화")

In May, General Xavier Brunson, commander of USFK and the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command, said, "There are times when I can't sleep thinking about how we would fight without decisive and reliable assets on the Korean Peninsula, which is why we want to bring the Multi-Domain Task Force into South Korea." The U.S. Army, which established the first Multi-Domain Task Force in 2019, currently operates three such task forces, with two already deployed to the Indo-Pacific region. If part of the 2nd Task Force responsible for Europe is also moved to the Korean Peninsula, it is expected that U.S. Army forces forward-deployed within the first island chain will be able to independently deter North Korean provocations across multiple domains while also checking China. (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관 겸 한미연합사령관은 지난 5월 “한반도에 결정적이고 신뢰할 만한 자산이 없는데 어떻게 싸울 것인지 잠 못 이룰 때가 있고, 그래서 한국에 다영역 특임단을 들여오려 한다”고 말했다. 2019년 첫 다영역 특임단을 창설한 미 육군은 3개 특임단을 운용 중이며, 2개는 이미 인도·태평양 지역에 배치돼 있다. 유럽을 맡은 제2특임단 일부까지 한반도로 이동하면, 제1도련선 내부에 전진배치된 미 육군이 단독으로 다영역에서 북한의 도발을 억지하면서 중국도 견제하는 효과가 있을 것으로 예상된다.)

The brigade-level Multi-Domain Task Force consists of a Multi-Domain Effects Battalion, a Long-Range Fires Battalion, and an Air Defense Battalion. Among these, the unit known to be moving to South Korea is the Multi-Domain Effects Battalion, which was stationed in Wiesbaden, Germany. The Multi-Domain Effects Battalion detects enemy movements through various channels—including reconnaissance satellites, space sensors, unmanned aerial vehicles, and over-the-horizon radar—and integrates this with military intelligence and signals intelligence to assess the theater situation. It is also known to possess capabilities for conducting cyber attacks, electronic jamming and interference, space warfare, and psychological operations. (여단급인 다영역 특임단은 다영역 효과대대, 장거리 화력대대, 방공 대대 등으로 구성된다. 그중 한국으로 이동할 것으로 알려진 부대는 독일 비스바덴에 주둔하고 있던 다영역 효과대대다. 다영역 효과대대는 정찰 위성, 우주 센서, 무인기, 초지평선 레이더 등 다양한 경로로 적의 동향을 탐지하고 이를 군사 정보, 신호 정보와 통합해 전구(戰區) 상황을 판단한다. 사이버 공격, 전파 방해·간섭, 우주전, 심리전 등을 수행할 역량도 갖춘 것으로 알려져 있다.)

Defense Minister nominee Kang Shin-chul said of the Multi-Domain Effects Battalion on a YouTube program last year, "Rather than the range or destructive power of a single weapons system itself, the systemic change of units deployed on the Korean Peninsula acquiring multi-domain operational capabilities poses a far greater threat and burden to North Korea." Military experts believe that if the Multi-Domain Effects Battalion, equipped with early detection capabilities, is forward-deployed to the Korean Peninsula and serves as the "eyes and ears" of the 210th Field Artillery Brigade under the 2nd Infantry Division of the Eighth Army—which operates Multiple Launch Rocket Systems (MLRS) and Army Tactical Missile Systems (ATACMS)—precision strike capabilities will also be maximized. (강신철 국방부 장관 후보자는 지난해 한 유튜브에서 다영역 효과대대에 대해 “단일 무기체계의 사거리나 파괴력 자체보다, 한반도에 배치된 부대가 다영역 작전 능력을 갖추게 되는 시스템적인 변화가 북한에게 훨씬 더 위협적이고 큰 부담을 준다”고 했다. 군 전문가들은 조기 탐지 능력을 갖춘 다영역 효과대대가 한반도에 전진배치돼 다연장 로켓(MLRS)과 전술 지대지 미사일(ATACMS)을 운용하는 미8군 2사단 예하 210야전포병여단의 ‘눈과 귀’ 역할을 해주면 정밀 타격 능력도 극대화될 것으로 보고 있다.)

However, there are reportedly no discussions yet regarding the forward deployment of the Multi-Domain Task Force's Long-Range Fires Battalion, which possesses hypersonic missiles such as the "Dark Eagle," to the Korean Peninsula. A military source said, "The South Korean government will inevitably have to be mindful of backlash from neighboring countries." The Long-Range Fires Battalion and Air Defense Battalion of the 2nd Multi-Domain Task Force, based in the continental United States, are also known to be capable of deploying to the Korean Peninsula or Japan in times of contingency. <<>> (다만 극초음속 미사일 ‘다크 이글’ 등을 가진 다영역 특임단 장거리 타격대대의 경우, 아직 한반도 전진배치 논의가 없는 것으로 알려졌다. 군 소식통은 “한국 정부로서는 주변국의 반발을 의식할 수밖에 없을 것”이라고 했다. 미 본토에 있는 제2 다영역 특임단의 장거리 화력대대와 방공대대도 유사시 한반도·일본에 전개할 수는 있는 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Yong Hye-in 'real estate flipping' suspicion... Even ruling party is unsettled (용혜인 ‘부동산 단타’ 의혹까지… 與도 술렁)
item.description:
Yong Hye-in 'real estate flipping' suspicion... Even ruling party is unsettled (용혜인 ‘부동산 단타’ 의혹까지… 與도 술렁)

As Basic Income Party lawmaker Yong Hye-in, nominated by President Lee Jae-myung as Minister of Gender Equality and Family, announced she would serve as minister while retaining her proportional representation seat, breaking convention, voices within the Democratic Party leadership have emerged saying she "should resign her seat." The People Power Party claims she is "not resigning in order to receive national subsidies amounting to 1.1 billion won per year." (이재명 대통령이 성평등가족부 장관 후보자로 지명한 기본소득당 용혜인 의원이 관례를 깨고 비례대표 의원직을 유지한 채 장관직을 수행하겠다고 밝힌 가운데, 더불어민주당 지도부에서도 “의원직을 사퇴해야 한다”는 목소리가 나왔다. 국민의힘에선 “연간 11억원에 달하는 국고 보조금을 받으려고 사퇴하지 않는 것”이라고 주장하고 있다.)

The People Power Party on the 1st raised a new suspicion that candidate Yong engaged in real estate 'flip trading.' Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo said that day, "Candidate Yong purchased a house in Ansan, Gyeonggi Province in April 2021 and sold it to a Chinese national in March 2022, earning a capital gain of 20 million won in less than a year," adding, "By the standards of the Lee Jae-myung administration, this is flip trading aimed at capital gains, not for actual residence purposes." Joo also said, "A lawmaker who should protect the interests of Korean nationals has effectively cooperated with Chinese nationals' real estate shopping." Candidate Yong had considered running in constituencies such as Ansan, Gyeonggi Province, in the 2024 general election but instead ran as a proportional representative and was elected to a second term. (국민의힘은 1일 용 후보자가 부동산 ‘단타 매매’를 했다는 의혹을 새롭게 제기했다. 주진우 의원은 이날 “용 후보자가 2021년 4월 경기 안산에 있는 주택을 매수한 뒤 2022년 3월 중국인에게 되팔아 1년도 안 돼 시세 차익 2000만원을 얻었다”며 “이재명 정부 기준대로라면 실거주 목적이 아닌, 시세 차익을 노린 단타 매매”라고 했다. 또 주 의원은 “자국민의 이익을 지켜야 할 국회의원이 중국인 부동산 쇼핑에 협조한 격”이라고도 했다. 용 후보자는 2024년 총선 때 경기 안산 등 출마를 고려하다가 비례대표로 출마해 재선 국회의원에 당선됐다.)

Controversies surrounding candidate Yong are growing. In particular, regarding the fact that candidate Yong's husband is an official of the Basic Income Party, the People Power Party is attacking her, saying, "It's the 'Family Income Party'" and "Isn't the reason she won't resign her seat because of her husband's salary?" Candidate Yong's husband, Park Ki-hong, served as secretary-general and head of planning and coordination for the Basic Income Party, and currently holds the position of deputy head of strategic planning. It is not known how much Park received as salary while holding party positions. Candidate Yong, born in 1990, came from left-leaning parties such as the Labor Party before leading the founding of the Basic Income Party. For this reason, the opposition is suspecting, "Isn't it like the old activist movement, creating a party and being self-sufficient within it?" (용 후보자를 둘러싼 각종 논란은 커지고 있다. 특히 용 후보자 남편이 기본소득당 당직자인 점을 두고 국민의힘에선 “가족소득당” “의원직 사퇴 안 하는 게 남편 월급 때문이냐”고 공격하고 있다. 용 후보자 남편 박기홍씨는 기본소득당 사무총장·기획조정실장 등을 거쳐 지금은 전략기획부총장을 맡고 있다. 박씨가 당직을 맡으면서 월급으로 얼마를 받았는지는 알려지지 않았다. 1990년생 용 후보자는 좌파 성향의 노동당 등을 거친 뒤 기본소득당 창당을 주도했다. 이 때문에 야당에선 “과거 운동권처럼 당을 만들어 내부에서 자급자족을 한 것 아니냐”는 의심을 하고 있다.)

The Basic Income Party received approximately 277 million won in subsidies last month after winning 0.99% of the vote for metropolitan proportional representation in the June 3 local elections, and if it remains a parliamentary party, it will receive these subsidies every quarter until the next local elections. That amounts to about 1.1 billion won per year. However, if candidate Yong resigns and the Basic Income Party becomes a non-parliamentary party, it would not receive a single won in subsidies. (기본소득당은 지난 6·3 지방선거 광역 비례 0.99%를 득표하면서 지난달 2억7700여 만원의 보조금을 받았고, 원내 정당으로 남는다면 다음 지방선거까지 분기마다 이 보조금을 받게 된다. 1년에 약 11억원을 받는 것이다. 그러나 용 후보자가 사퇴해 기본소득당이 원외 정당이 되면 보조금을 한 푼도 받을 수 없게 된다.)

Within the Democratic Party as well, there are arguments that candidate Yong should resign her seat if she is ultimately appointed as minister after the confirmation hearing. Pro-Lee Supreme Council member Park Sun-won said on YTN Radio that day, "For proportional representation seats, the next person in line is already registered with the National Election Commission," and "Candidate Yong should naturally resign her proportional representation seat." Park added, "They say 'if she resigns, the party becomes non-parliamentary,' but that aspect should be judged wisely," and "Public opinion seems to be leaning that way too." If candidate Yong, elected as a proportional representative of the Democratic Party's satellite party, resigns, the Democratic Party would inherit the next proportional representative slot. (민주당에서도 용 후보자가 청문회를 거쳐 최종 장관직으로 임명되면 의원직을 사퇴해야 한다는 주장이 나온다. 친명계 박선원 민주당 최고위원은 이날 YTN라디오에서 “비례대표직은 다음 순번이 이미 중앙선거관리위원회에 등록돼 있다”며 “용 후보자가 당연히 비례대표직을 사퇴하는 게 맞는다”고 했다. 박 최고위원은 “‘사퇴하면 원외 정당이 된다’고 말하는데, 그런 면은 현명하게 판단해야 한다”며 “여론도 그런 것 같다”고 했다. 민주당 위성정당 비례대표로 당선된 용 후보자는 사퇴하면 민주당이 후순위 비례대표를 승계하게 된다.)

Candidate Yong is expected to state her position on the 2nd upon her first day at the preparation office for the confirmation hearing. (용 후보자는 2일 인사청문회 준비 집무실에 첫 출근을 하면서 입장을 밝힐 예정이다.)

item.title: Even After Cabinet Reshuffle, Public Opinion Worsens... President Lee Accepts Chief of Staff Kim Yong-beom's Resignation (개각에도 여론 악화되자… 李, 김용범 실장 사표 수리)
item.description:
Even After Cabinet Reshuffle, Public Opinion Worsens... President Lee Accepts Chief of Staff Kim Yong-beom's Resignation (개각에도 여론 악화되자… 李, 김용범 실장 사표 수리)

Kim Yong-beom, chief of staff for policy at the presidential office, expressed his intention to resign on the 31st, and President Lee Jae-myung accepted the resignation on the 1st. This marks the first time a presidential chief of staff has stepped down since the current administration took office. As the president's approval rating fell amid controversies over the introduction of single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which triggered sharp fluctuations in the stock market, and disputes over real estate measures, interpretations emerged that Kim, identified as the policy control tower, was effectively dismissed. (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 지난 31일 사의를 표했고 이재명 대통령이 1일 사표를 수리했다. 현 정부 출범 이후 청와대 실장이 사퇴한 건 처음이다. 주식시장 급변동을 야기한 단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 도입과 부동산 대책 논란 등으로 대통령 지지율이 하락하자, 정책 컨트롤타워로 지목된 김 실장이 사실상 경질됐다는 해석이 나왔다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong announced Kim's resignation through an emergency briefing at 8:50 a.m. that day. This came just two days after a cabinet reshuffle was announced on the 30th, which replaced the economic and real estate policy lineup, including Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy Koo Yoon-cheol and Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok. Senior Press Secretary Kang emphasized that this was a "natural replacement," noting that "the average tenure of presidential office aides is about 1 year and 2 months to 1 year and 6 months." However, political circles interpret the move as a replacement driven by the failure of public sentiment to recover even after the reshuffle. In particular, it is known that even the ruling party had strongly demanded Kim's replacement. (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 오전 8시 50분 긴급 브리핑을 통해 김 실장의 사퇴를 알렸다. 지난 30일 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관, 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관 등 경제·부동산 정책 라인을 교체하는 개각이 발표된 지 이틀 만이다. 강 수석대변인은 “청와대 참모의 평균 재임 기간은 1년 2개월에서 1년 6개월 정도”라며 ‘자연스러운 교체’라는 점을 강조했다. 하지만 개각 이후에도 민심이 회복되지 않은 데 따른 교체라는 게 정치권 해석이다. 특히 여당에서도 김 실장 교체를 강하게 요구했던 것으로 알려졌다.)

Until now, the presidential office had drawn a line against Kim's resignation, concerned that the blame for policy failures would be directed at the Blue House. It is also known that this is why President Lee did not include Kim in the list of personnel changes during the latest reshuffle. However, as public opinion showed no signs of rebounding even after the reshuffle, the president ultimately decided to replace Kim. The People Power Party is also demanding the resignation of Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won and Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin, who were involved in the introduction of single-stock leveraged ETFs. (그동안 청와대는 정책 실패의 책임이 청와대로 향할 것을 우려해 김 실장 사퇴에 선을 그어 왔다. 이 대통령이 이번 개각 때 김 실장을 인사 대상에 포함하지 않은 것도 이 때문으로 알려졌다. 그러나 개각 이후에도 여론이 반등할 기미가 없자 대통령이 결국 김 실장 교체를 결단했다고 한다. 국민의힘은 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 도입에 관여한 이억원 금융위원장, 이찬진 금융감독원장의 사퇴도 요구하고 있다.)

◇ Kim Yong-beom seemed to be staying... Why did it end in 'resignation' just two days after the reshuffle? (◇김용범 유임하는 듯했는데… 왜 개각 이틀 만에 ‘사퇴’로 끝냈나)

On the 31st, the day before submitting his resignation, Chief of Staff Kim Yong-beom was scheduled to attend the National Assembly's Budget and Accounts Committee in the afternoon to respond to opposition party questions regarding the government's economic policy direction, including the real estate tax reform plan. However, in the morning, he notified the Assembly of his absence and reportedly expressed his intention to resign to the president. A presidential office official said, "Kim's attendance at the National Assembly was unavoidable, including at the upcoming audits," adding, "The heated argument he had with People Power Party lawmaker Kim Eun-hye during his last appearance at the Assembly was also a burden, and it seems such factors influenced his decision to resign." The People Power Party had been attacking Kim, citing that his son works at a securities firm, claiming that the introduction of single-stock leveraged ETFs, which Kim led, was intended to boost securities firms' profits. (김용범 실장은 사표를 내기 전날인 지난 31일 오후 국회 예산결산위원회에 참석해 부동산 세제개편안 등 정부 경제 정책 기조에 대한 야당 질의에 답할 예정이었다. 하지만 오전 국회에 불참을 통보했고 대통령에게 사의를 표명한 것으로 알려졌다. 청와대 관계자는 “앞으로 있을 국정감사 등에서 김 실장의 국회 출석은 피할 수 없는 상황이었다”며 “지난번 국회 출석 때 국민의힘 김은혜 의원과 큰 소리로 언쟁을 벌인 것 등도 부담이어서, 이런 점도 사퇴 결심에 영향을 준 것 같다”고 했다. 국민의힘은 김 실장의 아들이 증권사에서 일한다는 점을 들어 김 실장이 주도한 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 도입이 증권사의 수익을 올려주기 위한 것이라고 공세를 펴왔다.)

Kim's resignation was made public when Chief of Staff for State Affairs Kang Hoon-sik announced it during a morning meeting on pending issues at the presidential office on the 1st. It is reported that most of the approximately 40 aides attending the meeting also first learned of the resignation at that gathering. Concerned about speculation that Kim's departure might trigger, the presidential office hastily scheduled a briefing for 9 a.m., then moved it up by 10 minutes to 8:50 a.m. (김 실장의 사퇴는 1일 오전 열린 청와대 현안 점검 회의에서 강훈식 비서실장이 공표하면서 알려졌다. 회의에 참석한 40여명 참모진 거의 대부분도 이 자리에서 사퇴 소식을 처음 접한 것으로 전해졌다. 청와대는 김 실장 사퇴가 불러올 억측을 우려해 서둘러 오전 9시 관련 브리핑을 공지했다가, 이를 8시 50분으로 10분 더 앞당겼다.)

That day, the presidential office held two press briefings regarding Chief of Staff Kim Yong-beom's resignation. The morning briefing only stated, "Kim expressed his intention to resign on the 31st, and President Lee accepted the resignation on the 1st." No further explanation was given. In the afternoon briefing, regarding the background of the resignation, it was said, "Presidential office aides serve an average of 1 year and 2 months to 1 year and 6 months, and are replaced to provide smooth momentum for policy implementation." The point was that since Kim had served for 15 months, this was a natural replacement. (이날 청와대는 김용범 실장 사퇴와 관련해 언론 브리핑을 두 차례 했다. 오전 브리핑에서는 “김 실장은 31일 사의를 표명했고, 이 대통령은 1일 사표를 수리했다”고만 했다. 다른 설명은 없었다. 오후 브리핑에서는 사퇴 배경에 대해 “청와대 참모는 평균 1년 2개월~1년 6개월 재임하고, 정책 집행에 원활한 동력을 제공하려고 교체된다”고 했다. 김 실장이 15개월 근무했기 때문에 자연스러운 교체라는 취지다.)

As recently as early August, when President Lee presided over two meetings to review stock market and real estate policies, Kim was reportedly not among those being criticized. One participant at the time said, "President Lee mainly directed sharp questions at Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok and Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won." (8월 초 이 대통령 주재로 두 차례의 증시·부동산 정책 점검 회의를 가졌을 때만해도 김 실장은 질책 대상에서 벗어나 있었다고 한다. 당시 한 참가자는 “이 대통령이 주로 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관과 이억원 금융위원장에게 매섭게 질문했다”고 했다.)

Subsequently, when the president effectively dismissed the economic line ministers on the 30th of last month but did not include Kim in the personnel changes, political circles said, "It's because the president has high trust in Kim." However, this was interpreted as meaning the policy direction led by the presidential office would remain unchanged, further worsening public sentiment. Indeed, both Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy nominee Lee Hyung-il and Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport nominee Hong Ji-sun, nominated by the president, were figures close to the current administration. In particular, nominee Hong is an aide who served as housing director during President Lee Jae-myung's tenure as Gyeonggi Province governor. As a result, the situation changed rapidly. Even within the ruling party, opposition emerged to keeping Kim, the economic policy control tower, in his position. Internally within the presidential office, there was reportedly a sentiment that "with an approval rating of 30%, it doesn't make sense that no one takes responsibility." (이어 대통령이 지난달 30일 경제 라인 장관들을 사실상 경질하면서도 인사 대상에 김 실장을 넣지 않자 정치권에선 “김 실장에 대한 대통령의 신임이 높기 때문”이란 말이 나왔다. 하지만 청와대가 주도해 온 정책 기조는 그대로 간다는 뜻으로 받아들여지면서 여론이 더 나빠졌다. 실제 대통령이 지명한 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관, 홍지선 국토부 장관 후보자 모두 현 정권과 가까운 인사였다. 특히 홍 후보자는 이재명 대통령의 경기지사 시절 주택실장을 지낸 참모다. 이에 상황은 급변했다. 여당에서도 경제정책 컨트롤 타워인 김 실장이 유임되는 것에 반대하는 의견을 냈다고 한다. 청와대 내부적으로도 “지지율 30%인데 누구 하나 책임지는 사람이 없다는 건 말이 안 된다”는 분위기였다고 한다.)

For this reason, although Kim stepped down in the form of a voluntary resignation, the dominant assessment is that it was a disciplinary measure. The single-stock leveraged ETFs, which Kim led, were identified as the main culprit amplifying volatility, and the real estate policy through tax reform was also cited as the biggest cause of worsening public sentiment. In particular, the decline in approval ratings among those in their 20s and 30s appears to have influenced Kim's replacement. A presidential office official said, "If you ask people in their 20s now about the names of politicians, they'd hardly know any, but everyone knows 'Kim Yong-beom,'" adding, "His notoriety has built up to some degree due to the single-stock leveraged ETFs, which has been a burden." Another presidential office official said, "Since late June, recommendations to dismiss Kim have been submitted to President Lee several times," adding, "They weren't accepted at the time, but the president must have also judged that he couldn't defy public sentiment amid the falling approval rating." Nevertheless, the presidential office maintains that Kim's resignation was not a dismissal. (이 때문에 김 실장이 자진 사퇴 형식으로 물러났지만 문책성 인사라는 평가가 지배적이다. 김 실장이 주도한 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF가 변동성을 키운 주범으로 지목됐고 세제 개편을 통한 부동산 정책도 민심 악화의 가장 큰 원인으로 꼽혔다. 특히 2030 지지율 하락이 김 실장의 교체에 영향을 준 것으로 보인다. 청와대 관계자는 “지금 20대에게 정치인 이름을 물어보면 거의 모를 테지만, ‘김용범’은 모두가 안다”며 “단일 종목 레버리지 ETF로 인해 어느 정도 악명이 쌓인 게 있어 부담을 주고 있다”고 했다. 청와대 관계자는 “6월 말부터 김 실장을 경질해야 한다는 건의가 이 대통령에게 몇 차례 올라갔다”며 “그때는 받아들여지지 않았지만 대통령도 지지율 추락세에 민심을 거스를 수 없다는 판단을 하지 않았겠냐”고 했다. 다만 청와대는 김 실장의 사퇴가 경질 차원은 아니라는 입장이다.)

Attention is also growing over who will succeed Kim. The presidential office stated, "This personnel reshuffle itself is a measure to revitalize and accelerate the second-term economic policy lineup, and we will ensure there is no disruption to state affairs," adding, "We will ensure that follow-up appointments are not delayed." The presidential office is said to be seeking someone capable of leading the 'Mega Project,' a core initiative of the Lee Jae-myung administration. Accordingly, there is speculation that a bureaucrat with corporate experience, like Kim, could be selected. (김 실장 후임으로 누가 올지에 대한 관심도 커지고 있다. 청와대는 “이번 인적 개편 자체가 2기 경제 정책 라인 활성화 및 가속화를 위한 조치인 만큼, 국정 수행에 차질이 없도록 할 것”이라며 “후속 인사가 늦어지지 않도록 할 것”이라고 했다. 청와대는 이재명 정부의 핵심 사업인 ‘메가 프로젝트’를 주도할 만한 인사를 찾고 있다고 한다. 이에 김 실장처럼 기업 경험이 있는 관료를 발탁할 가능성이 나온다.)

Within the ruling camp, Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jeong-kwan is being mentioned first. Minister Kim, a former Ministry of Strategy and Finance (now the Ministry of Finance and Economy) official, moved to the Doosan Group in 2018 and was then selected for the current administration's first cabinet. It is known that Minister Kim's background as a mainstream economic bureaucrat and the president's strong trust in him are cited as factors for his selection. However, since Minister Kim is overseeing the major pending issue of U.S. investment at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, there is talk that it would be difficult for him to move to the policy chief position immediately. (여권에선 김정관 산업통상부 장관이 우선 거론된다. 김 장관은 기획재정부(현 재정경제부) 출신으로 2018년 두산그룹으로 자리를 옮긴 뒤 현 정부 초대 내각에 발탁됐다. 김정관 장관의 경우 정통 경제 관료 출신에 이 대통령의 신임이 큰 점 등이 발탁 요인으로 꼽히는 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 김 장관이 산업통상부 주요 현안인 대미(對美) 투자 문제를 총괄하고 있는 만큼, 당장 정책실장으로 오긴 어렵다는 말이 나온다.)

Names such as Koh Hyung-kwon, vice chairman of BS Group, a former Ministry of Strategy and Finance official who was mentioned as a candidate for the first policy chief at the start of the administration; Kim Yi-tae, president of Samsung Card; and Lee Ho-seung, former presidential chief of staff for policy, are also being floated again. Additionally, Minister of Climate and Energy Kim Sung-hwan, Presidential Secretary for Economic Growth Ha Joon-kyung, and Deputy Chairman of the National Economic Advisory Council Kim Sung-sik are also mentioned as potential picks. <<>> (정부 출범 당시 초대 정책실장으로 거론됐던 기재부 관료 출신인 고형권BS그룹 부회장, 김이태 삼성카드 사장, 이호승 전 청와대 정책실장 등의 이름도 다시 오르내리고 있다. 이밖에 김성환 기후에너지부 장관, 하준경 청와대 경제성장수석, 김성식 국민경제자문회의 부의장 등도 기용 가능성이 나온다.)
